# CartGain

> AI-powered cart recovery and negotiation platform for Shopify, WooCommerce, and other e-commerce stores.

CartGain helps merchants recover abandoned carts with consent-gated WhatsApp and Email journeys, and converts price objections with an AI shopkeeper that never prices below the merchant-set floor.

## Key features

- AI cart recovery with explicit opt-in, quiet hours, and refund-aware analytics
- AI price negotiation widget with server-authoritative pricing and a real discount code
- Shopify and WooCommerce integrations
- Storefront experience studio, shopkeeper personalities, and A/B testing
- Legal pages, API docs, and a public demo
